name: Slimwick
subtitle: Resize & Shrink Photos, KB/MB
shortDescription: Image compressor and photo resizer: shrink pictures to 100 KB, 200 KB, 1 MB or any size. Batch compress JPEG, HEIC and PNG, strip location.
longDescription:
Image compressor and photo resizer for iPhone and iPad: reduce image size to a file size you choose (100 KB, 200 KB, 1 MB or any number), resize photos by pixels, and compress pictures in a batch. Everything runs on your device, with no account and no upload.

Forms and portals often want a photo under 100 KB or 200 KB, or no more than 1600 pixels wide, while your camera makes several megabytes. Slimwick closes that gap in a few taps. It searches for the best quality that still fits your limit, and tells you plainly when a limit cannot be met.

### Compress and Resize Photos
- Reduce image size to a target file size in KB or MB: 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB, or type your own.
- Resize by pixels: set the longest side, or set the quality yourself with a slider.
- Compress up to 30 photos at once and save them together.
- Output as JPEG, HEIC or PNG (PNG is lossless).
- Open photos from your library or from the Files app.

### See the Result Before You Save
- Original size, new size and percentage saved for every photo.
- Drag a slider to compare before and after, and pinch to zoom into the detail.

### Presets for Common Uploads
- One-tap presets for typical limits: under 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB and 2 MB, social and web pixel sizes, and combined size-and-pixel limits. Each preset list is dated. They are common limits, not official rules: always check the notice for your own form.

### Save and Share
- Save to Photos or Files, or share straight from the app.
- Make the text bigger with A+ and A-. Light design, iPhone and iPad layouts.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
